resources.string: On the laptop, run %1$s. It shows the address, a one-time code and the certificate fingerprint.
Wi-Fi or Tailscale address. Port 8760 if you leave it out.
Shown in the laptop\'s device list
This phone was removed from the laptop. Pair it again.
The laptop at %1$s answered with this certificate. All 16 groups must match what pair shows on the laptop.
Tailscale address: there is no certificate to compare. WireGuard encrypts this connection.
A code works once and expires after 5 minutes. Run %1$s again on the laptop for a new one.
Enter the IP address, like 192.168.1.23 or 100.101.102.103
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535
Only a home or office Wi-Fi address (192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16–31.x) or a Tailscale address (100.64–127.x) works. Aristotle never connects over the public internet.
Can\'t reach this address. Check it, and check that aristotle-server is running on the laptop.
The laptop doesn\'t accept this phone on that address (different network). Use another address that pair shows.
Something answered here, but without a certificate. On Wi-Fi, use the Wi-Fi address that pair shows.
Not paired. Another device may be answering at this address. Check that the phone is on your own Wi-Fi and that the address is the one pair shows.
The certificate changed after you compared it. Not paired; start again.
The laptop could not save this phone. Run %1$s again.
Sessions open in Hermes on the laptop show up here.
aristotle-server on %1$s answered, but Hermes is not running there. Start Hermes on the laptop, then retry.
Hermes on %1$s now speaks a newer protocol than this aristotle-server knows, so the server stopped relaying to stay safe. Update aristotle-server on the laptop.
The connection to aristotle-server on %1$s ended or could not start. Check that the laptop is awake and on the same network, then retry.

Aristotle refused to connect: %1$s answered with a different certificate than the one you confirmed when pairing. If aristotle-server\'s key was deleted, pair again. Otherwise another device may be answering at this address.
